description: Main source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game. Contains app setup, theming, game state management, UI layout, and core game logic.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the theme and navigates to the main game page.

classes.name: TicTacToePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main game screen, managing game state and user interactions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application that runs the TicTacToeApp widget.

methods.name: _resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.

methods.name: _handleTap
methods.description: Handles user taps on a game cell, updating state and checking for win/draw conditions.

methods.name: _checkWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner and returns the winning line indices.

methods.name: _buildCell
methods.description: Builds individual cell widgets for the game grid.

methods.name: get _statusText
methods.description: Provides status message about game progress, win, or draw.
